description: Find US hospitals by state, city, county, ZIP code (5 digits, or a 3-digit prefix for the area) or name, with each hospital's CMS overall star rating (1 to 5), HCAHPS patient survey summary stars, type, ownership and ER availability. Best rated first, with the count at each star level. Filter by type, minimum stars or emergency services.

emergency_services.description: Only hospitals with an emergency department.

limit.description: How many hospitals to list, 1 to 50. Default 20.

min_stars.description: Only hospitals with at least this overall star rating.

state.description: State code or name, such as MA or Massachusetts.

zip.description: ZIP code (02114) or a 3-digit ZIP prefix for the surrounding area (021).

name: hospital_search
title: Find and rank hospitals
